name: Euler Angle Rotation Matrix Computation
definition: Calculates unit steps in display space by transforming unit vectors from object space using a rotation matrix defined by three user-supplied angles. The results are stored in global variables named 'unit.step.xx' through 'unit.step.zz'.
summary: Euler Angle Rotation Matrix Computation calculates Z-Y-X rotation matrices for volume rendering ray generation, storing results in global variables rather than structured objects.
